summary: 含氟阿普唑仑，可能半衰期更长、效力更高于母体化合物。
effectsSummary: Flualprazolam is a potent benzodiazepine with anxiolytic, sedative and sleep-inducing effects.
generalRisks: Sedation, impaired coordination and memory. High potency means greater risk of overdose. Dangerous with other depressants.
longtermRisks: Regular use leads to dependence. Withdrawal can be severe.
saferUse: 如果在线购买，实际成分可能与标识不同。
